scope: Production catalog and shared controller targeting; all purchases supplied for inspection, not earned-route evidence

skills.name: Headshot
skills.description: A precise physical shot. Power 95, Strength scaling, cooldown 2. Does not bypass armor.

skills.name: Smoke Bomb
skills.description: A dense smoke cloud raises Nova’s Evasion by 15 for 2 turns.

skills.name: Arc Tether
skills.description: Ground an enemy with Nova’s high-voltage line. Deals Shock damage and can inflict Short, which costs the target a turn.

skills.name: Cryo Vent
skills.description: Purges pressurized coolant through the cutter shroud, freezing armor plates and applying Brittle for 2 turns. Physical attacks deal +50% damage to Brittle targets.

skills.name: Plasma Burst
skills.description: Overdrives the cutter nozzle to hose the enemy formation in superheated gas, triggering Meltdown.

skills.name: Rend Round
skills.description: A barbed flechette round calibrated to bite deep into armor seams. Deals massive bonus damage and Bleed against staggered targets.

skills.name: Shatter Blow
skills.description: A heavy piston strike that deals Physical damage and applies Discord. The target deals 25% less damage for 2 of its turns.

skills.name: Bulwark Stance
skills.description: Plants magnetic boots and locks reinforced forearm plates into place, granting Guard and Braced.

skills.name: Overload Fists
skills.description: Shorts maintenance capacitors through his gauntlets, delivering a concussive jolt that shocks the target.

skills.name: Quake Slam
skills.description: Slams the deck with pneumatic force. Damages all enemies and applies Discord. Deals 65% more damage to targets that are Stunned or Staggered.

skills.name: Prism Lance
skills.description: Focus harmonic light through a crystal. Acid damage, power 85, Focus scaling, cooldown 2.

skills.name: Nano Repair
skills.description: Deploys an aerosol of medical nanites that knit flesh and seal torn suits over time.

skills.name: Disruption Pulse
skills.description: An inverted resonance wave applies Discord to all enemies, reducing their outgoing damage.

skills.name: Stasis Field
skills.description: Generates a localized cryogenic dampening sphere that flash-freezes the opposing vanguard.

skills.name: Venom Edge
skills.description: Coats a vibroblade in caustic slag runoff, carving open armor seams and leaving lingering Erosion.

skills.name: System Crash
skills.description: Injects an overload virus into target kinetic systems, shutting down their response loop with Stun.

skills.name: Shadow Flurry
skills.description: Steps through blind spots in a blur of blade strikes, leaving the entire enemy squad Bleeding.

skills.name: Blast Wave
skills.description: Unleashes a concussive pulse of raw Source kinetic energy, shattering Guard across all enemies and inflicting Stun.

skills.name: Signal Jammer
skills.description: Floods tactical frequencies with screeching white noise, silencing automated systems and confusing organic targets.

skills.name: Hydraulic Kick
skills.description: Drive a powered work boot into the target. Strips Guard and shields before dealing damage, then applies Discord to reduce the target’s damage.

skills.name: Pulse Grenade
skills.description: Throw an excavation charge for Physical damage to all enemies. Staggered targets skip their next turn.

skills.name: Scrap Shot
skills.description: Fires a rapid spray of jagged slag debris from the cutter muzzle. Fast and dependable, but lacks armor penetration.

skills.name: Cheap Shot
skills.description: Kicks a blinding flurry of metal filings into the target's optics, applying Discord to cut their outgoing damage.

skills.name: Synergy Pitch
skills.description: Hurls a deployable hard-light emitter, anchoring an auxiliary kinetic Barrier around a frontline ally.

skills.name: Field Patch
skills.description: Treat one living ally: 18 base healing scaled by Focus, plus Shield for 1 turn. No resurrection.

skills.name: Target Lock
skills.description: Applies Marked to one enemy. Attacks that hit it while Marked deal critical damage.

skills.name: Slide Kick
skills.description: Drops low across the metal grating to sweep the target's legs or treads, shattering Guard and causing Stagger.

skills.name: Intercept
skills.description: Gh0st braces himself with Guard: halves incoming damage and prevents stagger for 1 turn.

skills.name: Scan
skills.description: Use the Lens to reveal hidden routes and expose enemy harmonic weaknesses.

skills.name: Phase Counter
skills.description: Gh0st strikes with the opening his override key gives him, dealing damage and applying Discord to one enemy.

skills.name: Construct
skills.description: Use the Anvil to shape Source intent into a temporary barrier or strike.

skills.name: Harden
skills.description: Gh0st hardens his stance with Phantom combat data, gaining Guard, Shield, and Braced stability.

skills.name: Corporate Insight
skills.description: While Nova is above half HP, grants +10 percentage points of accuracy and critical chance.

skills.name: Sunbeam
skills.description: Orion focuses stored solar energy into a burning Source beam.

skills.name: Stasis
skills.description: Use the Anchor to freeze a target in a fixed moment, stopping even self-repairing machines.

skills.name: Data Shield
skills.description: While Zeke is alive, protects the party from hostile Silence, Jammed, and Short Circuit statuses.

skills.name: Legacy
skills.description: While Nova is below half HP, grants +15 percentage points of accuracy and critical chance.

skills.name: Unshackled
skills.description: Grants Zeke +3 Agility and +2 Speed.

skills.name: Source Balance
skills.description: Grants Gh0st +5 flat damage reduction and 25% Source resistance.

skills.name: Ancestral Grace
skills.description: Orion begins each battle with Regen for three turns.

skills.name: Tune World
skills.description: Open the Starborn circuit and rewrite one catastrophic resonance through collective intent.

skills.name: Guardian Covenant
skills.description: Apply Shield and Braced across the party through the recovered guardian bus.

skills.name: Link
skills.description: Restore party HP and apply Regen through the Bridge ground. Does not share damage.

skills.name: Breaker Bolt
skills.description: A focused physical shot dealing 50% more stability damage, without a status effect.

skills.name: Scatter Charge
skills.description: Scatter a low-powered physical charge across the enemy formation.

skills.name: Cover
skills.description: Shield one living ally for 2 turns.

skills.name: Field Treatment
skills.description: Restore 20% of one living ally maximum HP; no Focus multiplier.

skills.name: Disarm
skills.description: Physical shot applying Weak for 2 turns.

Saboteur.name: Grounded Wire
Saboteur.description: Arc Tether deals 20% more stability damage. HP damage and Shock are unchanged.

Saboteur.name: Controlled Vent
Saboteur.description: Cryo Vent power rises from 55 to 65. It applies Brittle for 2 turns, without freezing the target.

Saboteur.name: Breaker Bolt
Saboteur.description: Physical shot at one enemy: 100 power, Agility scaling, cooldown 3. Deals 50% more stability damage; applies no status.

Saboteur.name: Exposed Seam
Saboteur.description: Direct hits deal 15% more HP damage against Weak or Brittle targets. Having both does not double the bonus.

Improviser.name: Scatter Charge
Improviser.description: Physical damage to all enemies: 60 power, Agility scaling, cooldown 2. Applies no status.

Improviser.name: Hot Start
Improviser.description: Direct hits deal 15% more HP damage against targets above 75% HP.

Improviser.name: Keep Moving
Improviser.description: A direct-action kill grants Nova Shield for 1 personal turn. Once per action, at most twice per battle.

Protector.name: Cover
Protector.description: New active: one living ally, including Zeke; cooldown 3 personal turns; applies Shield for 2 target turns (25% less incoming damage under the reviewed Shield rule); no heal, damage or interception.

Protector.name: Reinforced Harness
Protector.description: Permanent +1 Vitality. Derived maximum HP and defense change through their shared formulas; no duplicate flat HP bonus.

Protector.name: Steady Cover
Protector.description: Cover additionally restores 20 stability to its target, capped at that target current maximum. Does not heal HP, remove an existing skip effect or grant a turn.

Protector.name: Last Line
Protector.description: Once per battle, Zeke may cast Cover while it is on cooldown if the selected living ally is below 30% HP at commitment. Spend a normal ATB action, apply ordinary Cover and Steady Cover if learned, and restart Cover's full 3-turn cooldown. Consume the emergency charge only for a valid cast that bypassed an active cooldown. No extra Guard, stronger Shield, heal, free action or stacked Shield copy.

Disruptor.name: Training Session
Disruptor.description: Permanent +1 Strength; derived Attack changes through the shared formula.

Disruptor.name: Fault Line
Disruptor.description: Shatter Blow deals 20% more stability damage. Its HP damage, Weak duration and cooldown are unchanged.

Disruptor.name: Opening
Disruptor.description: When Shatter Blow successfully applies Weak, also mark that enemy for 2 target turns. The next direct damaging action from another crew member consumes the mark for +10% HP damage against that enemy. One mark per target; reapplication refreshes but does not stack; damage-over-time and Zeke own actions do not consume it.

Disruptor.name: Controlled Demolition
Disruptor.description: Zeke physical direct hits against an enemy with Weak deal 15% more stability damage. No HP damage bonus, immunity bypass or extra skipped turn.

Field Medic.name: Field Resilience
Field Medic.description: Permanent +1 Vitality; maximum HP and defense use the shared formulas.

Field Medic.name: Field Treatment
Field Medic.description: New active: one living ally; cooldown 4 personal turns; restore 20% of target derived maximum HP, rounded down with minimum 1 and capped at missing HP. No Focus multiplier, resurrection or baseline recovery-over-time effect.

Field Medic.name: Triage
Field Medic.description: Field Treatment restores an additional 5% of target maximum HP when the target is below 35% HP before the cast, for 25% total. Calculate the combined amount once, round down once, and emit one direct-heal event per target.

Field Medic.name: Aftercare
Field Medic.description: Field Treatment additionally applies Aftercare for 2 target turns: each turn-end restores floor(cast-time target maximum HP / 20), minimum 1, capped at missing HP. Aftercare and Regen share one recovery-over-time slot. Existing Regen has priority and retains its potency and remaining duration; this cast neither extends it nor queues Aftercare. Recasting Aftercare refreshes its own duration to 2 without stacking ticks; a later Regen replaces it. No resurrection, Focus multiplier or post-battle ticking.

Controller.name: Clear Focus
Controller.description: Permanent +1 Focus, using the shared potency/accuracy/critical/resistance formulas exactly once.

Controller.name: Prism Lens
Controller.description: Prism Lance deals 20% more stability damage. Its HP damage, element and cooldown are unchanged.

Controller.name: Safe Exposure
Controller.description: Prism Lance applies Weak for 1 target turn only if the target did not have Weak before the action and is not immune. An existing Weak is neither extended nor replaced by this talent.

Controller.name: Steady Field
Controller.description: Weak newly applied by Orion lasts 1 additional target turn, capped at 3. Does not change potency, extend existing effects retroactively, affect Frozen/Stun/Stagger or bypass immunity.

Precision.name: Scope
Precision.description: Headshot deals 10% more HP damage against a target at or above 75% HP when the hit is evaluated.

Precision.name: Steady Aim
Precision.description: Headshot gains 5 percentage points of critical chance, subject to the normal critical cap. No other action gains this bonus.

Precision.name: Execute
Precision.description: Gh0st single-target direct damaging skills deal 15% more HP damage to targets at or below 30% HP before the hit. No instant kill, boss exemption or damage-over-time bonus.

Precision.name: Cool Head
Precision.description: Landing a basic attack gives Gh0st one steady-shot charge. His next valid Headshot consumes it for +15% direct HP damage, even if that Headshot misses. Charges do not stack and expire at battle end; invalid or canceled actions consume none. Headshot keeps base cooldown 2, with no talent cooldown refund, ATB grant or critical-hit recharge. The shared +25% talent-damage cap includes Scope and Execute.

Tactical.name: Quick Position
Tactical.description: Permanent +1 Agility; Speed/evasion use their shared formulas. No immediate ATB grant.

Tactical.name: Surgical Strike
Tactical.description: Gh0st basic attack deals 20% more stability damage, with no HP damage or extra status bonus.

Tactical.name: Disarm
Tactical.description: New active: one enemy; physical; base power 60; agility scaling; cooldown 3 personal turns; applies Weak for 2 target turns, respecting immunity. No Stun, silence or instant kill.

Tactical.name: Recenter
Tactical.description: Once per battle, prevent a scheduled-turn skip caused by Stun or Stagger on Gh0st, removing those two effects from him. Frozen and other unhandled skip effects remain; if any would still skip this turn, do not activate or consume Recenter. Other statuses remain; no bonus action, counterattack, damage or team-wide immunity.
